scope: Ten independently authored semantic/failure/ownership/numeric and exact identity-boundary probes against built runtime; worker checks compare canonical identities and do not substitute for actual worker protocol tests.

tests.name: directional direct edges, finite cycles, no recursive target traversal
normalized duplicate edges and self edges cannot inflate fanout or discounts
distinct original required groups share one target without collapse; hand-derived BM25 discount
factory rejects malformed endpoints, accessors and multiword mappings before installation
fanout counts all configured targets; narrowed core variants and limit-zero cannot bypass full refusal
selected field liveness and empty branches are explicit, no hidden reverse or prefix matching
canonical worker identity includes normalized complete mappings, version and bounds
factory and queued query own input; same revision dictionary freshness after replacement
ordinary text and explicit NOT/OR preserve strictness and successful branch scoring
exact canonical worker identity cap accepts 8192 units and refuses 8193 independently of raw mapping ceiling
